title: Banishment of Sugreeva by Vali
introduction: Sugreeva informs Rama that Vali could not be appeased in spite of repeated requests as he is resolved to accept Sugreeva as an enemy. Vali banishes Sugreeva from the kingdom with the same thinking.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे दशमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 10th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततः क्रोध समाविष्टम् सम्रब्धम् तम् उपागतम् |
अहम् प्रसादयान् चक्रे भ्रातरम् हित काम्यया
verses.iast:
tataḥ krodha samāviṣṭam sam.hrabdham tam upāgatam |
aham prasādayān cakre bhrātaram hita kāmyayā
verses.translation: "Then desiring both of our well-being I have begged of my brother who is enveloped in anger and behaving capriciously.

verses.devanagari:
दिष्ट्या असि कुशली प्राप्तो निहतः च त्वया रिपुः |
अनाथस्य हि मे नाथः त्वम् एको अनाथ नन्दनः
verses.iast:
diṣṭyā asi kuśalī prāpto nihataḥ ca tvayā ripuḥ |
anāthasya hi me nāthaḥ tvam eko anātha nandanaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, orphan's, delight Rama, I addressed him like this, "Luckily you have eliminated the enemy and returned safely, and to an orphaned one like me you alone are the protector.

glosses.meaning: luckily, by you, enemy, is eliminated
to an orphaned one, to me, you, alone, are the protector.

verses.devanagari:
इदम् बहु शलाकम् ते पूर्ण चन्द्रम् इव उदितम् |
छत्रम् स वाल व्यजनम् प्रतीच्छस्व मया धृतम्
verses.iast:
idam bahu śalākam te pūrṇa candram iva uditam |
chatram sa vāla vyajanam pratīcchasva mayā dhṛtam
verses.translation: Let this regal umbrella unfolded like a full moon, with its many of its spikes, and with accompanying fur-fans may please be accepted while I hold it for you.

verses.devanagari:
आर्तस्य अथ बिला द्वारि स्थितः संवत्सरम् नृप |
दृष्ट्वा च शोणितम् द्वारि बिलात् च अपि समुत्थितम्
शोक संविग्न हृदयो भृशम् व्याकुलित इन्द्रियः |
अपिधाय बिल द्वारम् शैल शृङ्गेण तत् तदा
तस्मात् देशात् अपाक्रम्य किष्किन्धाम् प्राविशम् पुनः |
verses.iast:
ārtasya atha bilā dvāri sthitaḥ saṃvatsaram nṛpa |
dṛṣṭvA ca śoṇitam dvāri bilāt ca api samutthitam
śoka saṃvigna hṛdayo bhṛśam vyākulita indriyaḥ |
apidhāya bila dvāram śaila śṛñgeṇa tat tadā
tasmāt deśāt apākramya kiṣkindhām prāviśam punaḥ |
verses.translation: "Saddened I was after staying at the entrance of the cave for one year, oh, king, and on seeing the blood that started to flow from out the cave in the entrance my heart is engulfed in sadness and my senses perturbed very much, and then covering that cave's entrance with a hilltop, and departing from that country, I re-entered Kishkindha.

glosses.meaning: at that, cave's entrance, I stayed

glosses.itrans: atha bilaat samutthitam shoNitam dvaari dR^iSTvaa
glosses.iast: atha bilāt samutthitam śoṇitam dvāri dṛṣṭvā
glosses.devanagari: अथ बिलात् समुत्थितं शोणितं द्वारि दृष्ट्वा
glosses.meaning: then, from cave, started to flow, blood, at entrance, having seen
with a hill, top, having covered

verses.devanagari:
विषादात् इह माम् दृष्ट्वा पौरैः मंत्रिभिर् एव च
अभिषिक्तो न कामेन तन्मे क्षन्तुम् त्वम् अर्हसि |
verses.iast:
viṣādāt iha mām dṛṣṭvā pauraiḥ maṃtribhir eva ca
abhiṣikto na kāmena tanme kśantum tvam arhasi |
verses.translation: "On seeing me returning with grief, the citizens and ministers alike crowned me, but that is not at my desire, therefore it is apt of you pardon me.

glosses.meaning: with grief, [on my coming] here, me, on seeing
therefore, me, to pardon, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् एव राजा मानार्हः सदा च अहम् यथा पुरा
राजभावे नियोगः अयम् मम त्वत् विरहात् कृतः |
स अमात्य पौर नगरम् स्थितम् निहत कण्टकम्
verses.iast:
tvam eva rājā mānārhaḥ sadā ca aham yathā purā
rājabhāve niyogaḥ ayam mama tvat virahāt kṛtaḥ |
sa amātya paura nagaram sthitam nihata kaṇṭakam
verses.translation: "As an estimable one you alone are the king, and I will be as I was, and establishing me in kingship is owing to your unavailability, but the capital with citizens and ministers is kept up without thorniness.

glosses.meaning: I will be, as earlier, as I was

glosses.itrans: mama ayam raja bhaave niyogaH tvat virahaat kR^itaH
glosses.iast: mama ayam raja bhāve niyogaḥ tvat virahāt kṛtaḥ
glosses.devanagari: मम अयं रज भावे नियोगः त्वत् विरहात् कृतः
glosses.meaning: my, this, in kingship, establishment, with your, unavailability, it is done

verses.devanagari:
न्यास भूतम् इदम् राज्यम् तव निर्यातयामि अहम् |
मा च रोषम् कृथाः सौम्य मम शत्रु निषूदन
verses.iast:
nyāsa bhūtam idam rājyam tava niryātayāmi aham |
mā ca roṣam kṛthāḥ saumya mama śatru niṣūdana
verses.translation: "Oh, gentle one, I am now returning this custodial kingdom to you, oh, enemy eliminator, you need not be hostile towards me.

verses.devanagari:
याचे त्वाम् शिरसा राजन् मया बद्धो अयम् अंजलिः |
बलात् अस्मिन् समागम्य मंत्रिभिः पुर वासिभिः
राजभावे नियुक्तो अहम् शून्य देश जिगीषया |
verses.iast:
yāce tvām śirasā rājan mayā baddho ayam aṃjaliḥ |
balāt asmin samāgamya maṃtribhiḥ pura vāsibhiḥ
rājabhāve niyukto aham śūnya deśa jigīṣayā |
verses.translation: "I beg you with my bowed head and with my prayerful palm-fold, the ministers and the city dwellers have collectively and forcibly nominated me to the kingship, only to keep the kingless kingdom under control.

glosses.meaning: with head bowed, you, I beg
by me, this, [prayerful] palm-fold, is made
empty [kingless,] kingdom, to have control on

verses.devanagari:
स्निग्धम् एवम् ब्रुवाणम् माम् स विनिर्भर्त्स्य वानरः
धिक् त्वाम् इति च माम् उक्त्वा बहु तत् तत् उवाच ह |
verses.iast:
snigdham evam bruvāṇam mām sa vinirbhartsya vānaraḥ
dhik tvām iti ca mām uktvā bahu tat tat uvāca ha |
verses.translation: "While I was speaking that politely he threatened me and indeed used many expletives starting from 'fie, fie, upon you.' and the like.

glosses.meaning: this way, politely, while I was saying

verses.devanagari:
प्रकृतीः च समानीय मंत्रिणः चैव सम्मतान्
माम् आह सुहृदाम् मध्ये वाक्यम् परम गर्हितम् |
verses.iast:
prakṛtīḥ ca samānīya maṃtriṇaḥ caiva sammatān
mām āha suhṛdām madhye vākyam parama garhitam |
verses.translation: "And summoning people and venerable ministers he hurled very abusive words at me among friends.

verses.devanagari:
विदितम् वो मया रात्रौ मायावी स महाअसुरः
माम् समाह्वयत क्रुद्धो युद्ध कांक्षी तदा पुरा |
verses.iast:
viditam vo mayā rātrau māyāvī sa mahāasuraḥ
mām samāhvayata kruddho yuddha kāṃkṣī tadā purā |
verses.translation: "You all are aware that earlier the gigantic and rancorous demon Maayaavi invited me desiring a duel in that night.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तद् भाषितम् श्रुत्वा निःसृतः अहम् नृपाअलयात्
अनुयातः च माम् तूर्णम् अयम् भ्राता सुदारुणः |
verses.iast:
tasya tad bhāṣitam śrutvā niḥsṛtaḥ aham nṛpāalayāt
anuyātaḥ ca mām tūrṇam ayam bhrātā sudāruṇaḥ |
verses.translation: "On hearing his call for a duel I went out of the royal palace, and this very hazardous brother of mine quickly followed me.

glosses.meaning: from royal, palace su daaruNaH = very, hazardous one

verses.devanagari:
स तु दृष्ट्वा एव माम् रात्रौ स द्वितीयम् महाबलः
प्राद्रवत् भय संत्रस्तो वीक्ष्य आवाम् समुपागतौ |
अभिद्रुतः तु वेगेन विवेश स महाबिलम्
verses.iast:
sa tu dṛṣṭvā eva mām rātrau sa dvitīyam mahābalaḥ
prādravat bhaya santrasto vīkṣya āvām samupāgatau |
abhidrutaḥ tu vegena viveśa sa mahābilam
verses.translation: "And that formidable demon Maayaavi ran away as he was fraught with fear on seeing me with a second one at my side, and he speedily entered a great cavity of earth on seeing us two nearly reaching him.

glosses.itrans: raatrau sa dvitiiyam maam dR^iSTvaa eva
glosses.iast: rātrau sa dvitīyam mām dṛṣṭvā eva
glosses.devanagari: रात्रौ स द्वितीयं मां दृष्ट्वा एव
glosses.meaning: in night, with, a second one, me, on seeing, just by
those that reached nearly, at us, on seeing

verses.devanagari:
तम् प्रविष्टम् विदित्वा तु सुघोरम् सुमहद् बिलम् |
अयम् उक्तो अथ मे भ्राता मया तु क्रूर दर्शनः
verses.iast:
tam praviṣṭam viditvā tu sughoram sumahad bilam |
ayam ukto atha me bhrātā mayā tu krūra darśanaḥ
verses.translation: "On knowing the demon's entry into that great precarious cavity, I said to this one, this cruel looking brother of mine.

verses.devanagari:
अहत्वा न अस्ति मे शक्तिः प्रति गन्तुम् इतः पुरीम् |
बिल द्वारि प्रतीक्ष त्वम् यावत् एनम् निहन्मि अहम्
verses.iast:
ahatvā na asti me śaktiḥ prati gantum itaḥ purīm |
bila dvāri pratīkṣa tvam yāvat enam nihanmi aham
verses.translation: "My power will not let me return from here to the capital without killing that demon, hence you wait at this cavity's entrance, till I kill that demon and come out of the cavity.

verses.devanagari:
स्थितोऽयम् इति मत्वा अहम् प्रविष्टः तु दुरासदम् |
तम् मे मार्गयतः तत्र गतः संवत्सरः तदा
verses.iast:
sthito'yam iti matvā aham praviṣṭaḥ tu durāsadam |
tam me mārgayataḥ tatra gataḥ saṃvatsaraḥ tadā
verses.translation: "Believing that he stayed at the entrance of the cavity I entered that impenetrable cavity, and then in searching for that demon there one year elapsed.

verses.devanagari:
स तु दृष्टो मया शत्रुः अनिर्वेदात् भयाअवहः |
निहतः च मया सद्यः सः सर्वैः सह बन्धुभिः
verses.iast:
sa tu dṛṣṭo mayā śatruḥ anirvedāt bhayāavahaḥ |
nihataḥ ca mayā sadyaḥ saḥ sarvaiḥ saha bandhubhiḥ
verses.translation: "I have seen that terrified enemy of mine effortlessly, and I killed him immediately along with all of his relatives.

glosses.meaning: he, all of his, relatives, along with

verses.devanagari:
तस्य आस्यात् तु प्रवृत्तेन रुधिरौघेण तद् बिलम् |
पूर्णम् आसीत् दुराक्रामम् स्वनतः तस्य भूतले
verses.iast:
tasya āsyāt tu pravṛttena rudhiraugheṇa tad bilam |
pūrṇam āsīt durākrāmam svanataḥ tasya bhūtale
verses.translation: "That cavity has become impassable, since it is fully filled with the gushes of blood emanating from the mouth of that demon who fell yelling onto ground.

glosses.meaning: impossible, to tread, it has become.

verses.devanagari:
सूदयित्वा तु तम् शत्रुम् विक्रान्तम् तम् अहम् सुखम् |
निष्क्रामम् न एव पश्यामि बिलस्य पिहितम् मुखम्
verses.iast:
sūdayitvā tu tam śatrum vikrāntam tam aham sukham |
niṣ.hkrāmam na eva paśyāmi bilasya pihitam mukham
verses.translation: "On my killing that invading enemy easily, I could not see any exit from that cavity as its mouth was closed.

verses.devanagari:
विक्रोशमानस्य तु मे सुग्रीव इति पुनः पुनः |
यतः प्रतिवचो नास्ति ततः अहम् भृश दुःखितः
verses.iast:
vikrośamānasya tu me sugrīva iti punaḥ punaḥ |
yataḥ prativaco nāsti tataḥ aham bhṛśa duḥkhitaḥ
verses.translation: "Wherefore I did not get a reply though I repeatedly shouted, 'Sugreeva, oh, Sugreeva.' thereby I was very saddened.

verses.devanagari:
पाद प्रहारैः तु मया बहुभिः परिपातितम् |
ततः अहम् तेन निष्क्रम्य पथा पुरम् उपागतः
verses.iast:
pāda prahāraiḥ tu mayā bahubhiḥ paripātitam |
tataḥ aham tena niṣ.hkramya pathā puram upāgataḥ
verses.translation: "With my foot I pounded and smashed that lidded hilltop, and from there I exited that way and arrived here.

verses.devanagari:
तत्र अनेन अस्मि सम्रुद्धः राज्यम् मृगयत आत्मनः |
सुग्रीवेण नृशंसेन विस्मृत्य भ्रातृ सौहृदम्
verses.iast:
tatra anena asmi sam.hruddhaḥ rājyam mṛgayata ātmanaḥ |
sugrīveṇa nṛśaṃsena vismṛtya bhrātṛ sauhṛdam
verses.translation: "As such this cruel fantasist of kingdom trammelled me in there forgetting the clannishness." So said Vali to all the courtiers.

glosses.meaning: by cruel one, by this one

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्त्वा तु माम् तत्र वस्त्रेण एकेन वानरः |
तदा निर्वासयामास वाली विगत साध्वसः
verses.iast:
evam uktvā tu mām tatra vastreṇa ekena vānaraḥ |
tadā nirvāsayāmāsa vālī vigata sādhvasaḥ
verses.translation: "On saying thus that monkey ruthlessly banished me, then and there in the court itself, who am with a single clothing on my body.

glosses.meaning: started to render me homeless - banished me.

verses.devanagari:
तेन अहम् अपविद्धः च हृत दारः च राघव |
तत् भयात् च महीम् सर्वान् क्रान्तवान् स वन अर्णवाम्
verses.iast:
tena aham apaviddhaḥ ca hṛta dāraḥ ca rāghava |
tat bhayāt ca mahīm sarvān krāntavān sa vana arṇavām
verses.translation: "Thus he threw me away and even stole my wife, oh, Rama, and owing to his fear alone I roamed all over the earth with its forests and oceans.

glosses.meaning: withal, forests, oceans sarvaan = all over the

verses.devanagari:
ऋश्यमूकम् गिरि वरम् भार्या हरण दुःखितः |
प्रविष्टो अस्मि दुराधर्षम् वालिनः कारणान्तरे
verses.iast:
ṛśyamūkam giri varam bhāryā haraṇa duḥkhitaḥ |
praviṣṭo asmi durādharṣam vālinaḥ kāraṇāntare
verses.translation: "I who am saddened by stealing my wife have entered this safest mountain Rishyamuka, which is impenetrable for Vali by another reason.

glosses.meaning: wife, by stealing, I who am saddened

verses.devanagari:
एतत् ते सर्वम् आख्यातम् वैर अनुकथनम् महत् |
अनागसा मया प्राप्तम् व्यसनम् पश्य राघव
verses.iast:
etat te sarvam ākhyātam vaira anukathanam mahat |
anāgasā mayā prāptam vyasanam paśya rāghava
verses.translation: "All this notable account of enmity is reported to you, oh, Raghava, and you may examine the dire straits befallen on me at no fault of mine.

glosses.meaning: all this, notable, enmity, account of

verses.devanagari:
वालिनः च भयात् तस्य सर्वलोक भयापह |
कर्तुम् अर्हसि मे वीर प्रसादम् तस्य निग्रहात्
verses.iast:
vālinaḥ ca bhayāt tasya sarvaloka bhayāpaha |
kartum arhasi me vīra prasādam tasya nigrahāt
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, the fear-remover of all the worlds, it is apt of you to bestow me invulnerability from the fear of Vali, and oh, valiant one, as well as to rein him in." Sugreeva requested Rama thus.

glosses.meaning: to all, worlds, fear, remover - oh, Rama

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः स तेजस्वी धर्मज्ञो धर्म संहितम् |
वचनम् वक्तुम् आरेभे सुग्रीवम् प्रहसन् इव
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ sa tejasvī dharmajño dharma saṃhitam |
vacanam vaktum ārebhe sugrīvam prahasan iva
verses.translation: When he is requested thus by Sugreeva, that virtuous and resplendent Rama started to tell Sugreeva, the words that abide by virtue, as though trivializing the task on hand.

glosses.meaning: thus, one who is said - Rama

verses.devanagari:
अमोघाः सूर्य संकाशा निशिता मे शरा इमे |
तस्मिन् वालिनि दुर्वृत्ते पतिष्यन्ति रुष अन्विताः
verses.iast:
amoghāḥ sūrya saṅkāśā niśitā me śarā ime |
tasmin vālini dur.hvṛtte patiṣyanti ruṣa anvitāḥ
verses.translation: "Admirable and sun-like burners are these arrows of mine that are now mingled with my wrath, and they are bound fall on that evil minded Vali.

verses.devanagari:
यावत् तम् न हि पश्येयम् तव भार्य अपहारिणम् |
तावत् स जीवेत् पापात्मा वाली चारित्र दूषकः
verses.iast:
yāvat tam na hi paśyeyam tava bhārya apahāriṇam |
tāvat sa jīvet pāpātmā vālī cāritra dūṣakaḥ
verses.translation: "He that stealer of your wife, that evil-minded abuser of history lives as long as I descry.

verses.devanagari:
आत्म अनुमानात् पश्यामि मग्नः त्वाम् शोक सागरे |
त्वाम् अहम् तारयिष्यामि बाढम् प्राप्स्यसि पुष्कलम्
verses.iast:
ātma anumānāt paśyāmi magnaḥ tvām śoka sāgare |
tvām aham tārayiṣyāmi bāḍham prāpsyasi puṣkalam
verses.translation: "By my experience I see how you are deluged in a sea of sadness, but I will make you to get over that sea, and you will definitely regain abundantly whatever you lost." Rama assured Sugreeva thus.

glosses.meaning: by self, inference -by my own experience
you, I will, make you to get across

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा हर्ष पौरुष वर्धनम् |
सुग्रीवः परम प्रीतः सु महत् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tasya tat vacanam śrutvā harṣa pauruṣa vardhanam |
sugrīvaḥ parama prītaḥ su mahat vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Hearing that sentence of Rama, which is enhancing happiness and self-esteem, Sugreeva is very gladdened and further said this great sentence.
